given_when_then.given: An actor initiates the creation of a new customer account
given_when_then.when: The actor enters valid unique identifiers and verified contact details
given_when_then.then: The system creates a new Customer Profile with an active status and links it to the actor's session

given_when_then.given: A Customer Profile lacks a unique identifier
given_when_then.when: An actor attempts to associate an Order Request with the profile
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the association as the profile is not ready for orders

given_when_then.given: Contact details within a Customer Profile are not yet verified
given_when_then.when: An actor attempts to set the profile status to active
given_when_then.then: The system prevents the status change until contact verification is complete

given_when_then.given: An actor initiates an update to an Archived Customer Profile
given_when_then.when: The actor attempts to modify any historical data
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the modification and confirms the archival action remains intact

given_when_then.given: A Customer Profile has been modified
given_when_then.then: The modification is timestamped and attributed to the actor performing the change

success_criteria: The system successfully creates a Customer Profile with active status only when unique identifiers and contact details are verified.
The system prevents association of an Order Request with a Customer Profile that lacks a unique identifier.
The system enforces contact verification as a mandatory prerequisite before allowing a Customer Profile status to be set to active.
The system permanently prevents modification of data within an Archived Customer Profile after archival confirmation.
Every modification to a Customer Profile is recorded with a precise timestamp and the specific actor who performed the change.
The system displays a specific error message when an actor attempts to enter data that fails validation rules for required fields or format.
